title: Relation back of an amended claim or party
shortTitle: Relation back of an amended claim or party
summary: Relation back treats a qualifying amendment as connected to the original pleading for limitations purposes. Different provisions govern changed allegations and changed defendants.
notes: Krupski focuses on the correct defendant’s understanding. It does not eliminate the other conditions or equate a deliberate choice between correctly understood defendants with a mistake.

sections.Meaning: Relation back treats a qualifying amendment as connected to the original pleading for limitations purposes. Different provisions govern changed allegations and changed defendants.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify the transaction described originally, the nature of the change, and the applicable route under Rule 15(c). For a changed defendant, examine timely notice, prejudice, and whether the prospective defendant knew or should have known that a mistake explained the omission.
